activity.notes: Hirohito, posthumously Emperor Shōwa, acceded on 25 December 1926 and remained emperor until his death on 7 January 1989. The constitutional meaning of the imperial office changed fundamentally after World War II, but the personal imperial reign remained continuous; ATLAS therefore uses the broad political-community label Japan.
